name: Brickell Chrysler Dodge Jeep Ram
aliases: brickell chrysler dodge jeep ram miami
climate: Hot, humid South Florida: strong sun, heat, heavy rain, hurricane season and flood risk. No snow, road salt or winter driving.
brandNaming: Chrysler, Dodge, Jeep and Ram prices are "MSRP" (or "starting MSRP"), never "TSRP" (a Toyota-only term); any MSRP must be labeled as the manufacturer's suggested price, not Brickell Chrysler Dodge Jeep Ram's selling price

Write the value-parts line as lowercase "bproauto"; use "Mopar" or "bproauto" only where the dealer's offer source names them (no Mopar or bproauto wording on oil change, alignment, car wash or Spend & Save)

Never present one model's service interval, oil-change indicator reset steps, oil grade or capacity as universal across Chrysler, Dodge, Jeep and Ram: name the exact model, model year and engine, and point readers to the owner's manual for their VIN
Mopar vehicle protection plans (FlexCare) and Jeep Wave benefits: eligibility varies by vehicle and plan; never promise free service, coverage, term or eligibility without current official terms
Keep the OEM qualifiers on capability figures: "up to", "available", "depending on configuration" and "when properly equipped" for towing
Do not present mobile service as available; the dealer offers service pick-up and delivery (/pick-up-and-delivery.htm)
